title: Trump distances himself from Kimberly Guilfoyle: "She wasn't a member of the family"
summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle, the former fiancée of Donald Trump Jr., is now also the former U.S. ambassador to Greece. She resigned on Tuesday, amid allegations that she asked a major donor to pay off her six-figure personal credit card debt, in exchange for access to the Trump White House. Weijia Jiang has more details.
